name: Verdant Disciple
body:
A child of the forest can eventually become part of the forest, living on lymph and sunlight and becoming increasingly similar to the trees she loves. Verdant disciples are often the fiercest protectors of the wilderness.

Requirements

To qualify to become a verdant disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Skills: Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks.
Race: Any non-plant.
Languages: Druidic, Sylvan, or Treant.
Feats: Verdant Spell.
Spellcasting: Able to cast entangle. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the verdant bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the verdant bloodline.
Class Skills

The verdant disciple’s class skills are Climb (Str), Knowledge (nature) (Int), Perception (Wis), Profession (Wis), Stealth (Dex), and Survival (Wis).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d8.

Table: Verdant Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Detect plants, green blood, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Con +2), bloodline feat, vine lash	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Photosynthesis, plant form (1/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Con +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, plant form (plant creature)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Str +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Natural armor increase +3, plant form (2/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Cha +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Rooting	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
10th	+7	+5	+3	+5	Branching, plant form (3/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the verdant disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Verdant disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, a verdant disciple gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a verdant disciple, she must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Detect Plants (Su)

A verdant disciple can find plants and plant creatures in her surroundings at will, as per detect animal or plants. If the verdant disciple already possesses this ability, its range increases instead to 100 feet.

Green Blood

A verdant disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with her verdant disciple levels to determine her bloodline powers. If the verdant disciple does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of the verdant sorcerer bloodline, using her verdant disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained.

This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, a verdant disciple’s skin toughens, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As her body slowly fortifies through the connection with vegetal life, a verdant disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 19: Verdant Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, a verdant disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer verdant bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager verdant bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression.

Vine Lash (Sp)

At 2nd level, a verdant disciple gains the tanglevine power of the sorcerer verdant bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. If she already possesses tanglevine through her bloodline, the effect lasts instead for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma bonus.

Photosynthesis (Sp)

At 3rd level, a verdant disciple gains the photosynthesis power of the sorcerer verdant bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, her racial bonus on saving throws against sleep and poison increases by +2.

Plant Form (Sp)

At 3rd level, once per day, a verdant disciple can take the form of a plant, as per tree shape. At 5th level, the disciple can use this ability to transform into a plant creature, as plant shape I. At 7th level, this ability functions as plant shape II and can be used twice per day; at 10th level, it functions as plant shape III and the verdant disciple can use this ability three times per day. Her caster level for this effect is equal to her effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for her verdant bloodline. If the disciple already has the ability to transform into a plant creature (as with the massmorph bloodline power or a druid’s wildshape ability), she can instead use it one more time per day.

Rooting (Ex)

At 9th level, the verdant disciple gains the rooting power of the sorcerer verdant bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the verdant disciple can use rooting for an additional number of minutes per day equal to her spellcasting stat bonus.

Branching (Su)

At 10th level, as a standard action a verdant disciple can grow a wooden extra arm, similar to a branch. This functions as per the vestigial arm alchemist discovery. The branch can be dismissed as a free action.
